title: NEW DVD, “Bears” , Originally Presented In IMAX Theaters Slingshot Entertainment
descriptionText: The product is a new DVD titled "Bears," originally presented in IMAX theaters by Slingshot Entertainment. This family-friendly movie, rated NR, is part of the National Wildlife Federation franchise and features a run time of 1 hour and 30 minutes. It is in English language and released in 2002. This standard edition DVD is a great addition for fans of nature documentaries and wildlife films.
